dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a continuous concave curvature from the posterior basal ridge to the apex, following a smooth spline with increasing curvature toward the tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is classified as rounded with a small pixel radius, creating a narrow but non-acute tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a high angular steepness, approximately 80 degrees relative to the visible horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High vertical aspect ratio, with a measured base-to-height proportion of approximately 1:2.8.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous small, white punctate markings and superficial linear scratches are visible across the lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The fin displays an exceptionally erect, sword-like profile characteristic of a high-aspect-ratio silhouette.
